body:
Basically, I have a lot of experinece with Val, Xan, and the other Benzos.  I tried this first with a dose of 6mg.  I drank 24 oz of Heineken to help set it off.  Most benzos are felt within at least 20-30 minutes or so.  I did start to feel it, sort of a cross between Val and Xan.  Well, it was nice, but I also have a tolerance for benzos, (even though they're not supposed to have cross-tolerance between them), so 45 minutes in, my beer was finished and I took another 12mg.  I had read that it was weaker mg for mg than most benzodiazepines.  I started another beer, and about 15 minutes after the second dosing, I could definitely feel the light, euphoric feeling.  It was familiar and pleasant, but a little different than the other similar pharmaceuticals I'd been used to.  It never felt as strong as Xanax or Valium, or even Temazepam or Klonopin.  So, it was a nice change, and would probably be nice to throw in the mix with some other benzos.  Comparataively, on its own though, I felt it to be just a weaker version of a Val/Xan combo.  When looking at my dosages everyone though, take into account my weight and tolerance for benzos.
